name: Link
description: SEED contract for the ALTITUDE round — props/axes only; anatomy is promoted from captured DOM truth. Subject: altitude-web-components@1.0.2 (published npm, Lit 3, SHADOW DOM), pinned in examples/altitude/.altitude-sandbox (examples/altitude/PROVENANCE.md). EVERY enum in this library is DEFAULTLESS — the default rendering is the ABSENCE of the attribute (there is no `variant="primary"`; primary IS unset), so every axis leads with the `unset` pseudo-value. No `disabled` state plane: Altitude never reaches the `:disabled` pseudo-class from a prop on these components (al-button's isDisabled emits aria-disabled ONLY — measured identical background, cursor and opacity — and the other seven spell it as an `al-is-disabled` class, which is a prop-selected RENDERING, i.e. a variant axis, not a pseudo-class plane). al-link. `href` PINNED in fixedProps: the shadow template picks its ROOT ELEMENT from it (<a> when href is truthy, <button> otherwise), so leaving it unset would make the captured anatomy a function of a prop that is not an axis. `isDisabled` is an `al-is-disabled` class rendering (see above), not a state plane.
